The Crypto API is described in [13]. The model-path to an RPortPrototype that is referencing a CryptoInterface is provided by the ara::core::InstanceSpec- ifier that defines the logical local name used by the application developer in the API call. This local ara::core::InstanceSpecifier is translated at runtime with the information from the deployment model to a specific crypto object, e.g. CryptoKeySlot in a CryptoKeyStorage.
